body:
<!-- samuel:brief -->
> **What:** (1) A hook injects the wrap-up rule into sessions after 01:00 local. (2) A mod tells the agent to run the handoff skill when context use passes a threshold. (3) The unregistered `~/.claude/hooks/style-contract.sh` is deleted. (4) Once (1) works, the 1 AM line leaves `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`.
> **Why:** The 1 AM rule is prose and was broken on 19 of 35 nights in the September analysis. The owner's own lesson from that analysis: only what runs as a hook lasts.
> **Caveat:** Touches files outside this repo: `~/.claude/hooks/style-contract.sh`, `~/.claude/settings.json` (only if the hook is registered there) and `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`. Back up each before editing. `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` text must be first person; imperative edits get blocked by the auto-mode classifier.
> `size:M` `type:feat` `scope:samuel`

## Problem

- `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md:52` — "After 1:00 AM local, don't propose starting new work >30 min... I want it enforced as system, not intention." Nothing enforces it: `~/.claude/settings.json` hooks contain only the Orca agent hook on `UserPromptSubmit`/`SessionStart`/etc. and one `PreCompact` entry.
- No signal tells the agent that context is high; `plugins/samuel/skills/implement/SKILL.md:123-125` relies on "the harness has emitted a context warning".
- `~/.claude/hooks/style-contract.sh` (1,204 bytes, dated Jul 28) prints a `<style-contract>` block for `UserPromptSubmit`, but `grep -c style-contract ~/.claude/settings.json` = 0: it is not registered. The active output style is `Attention-kind` (`~/.claude/output-styles/attention-kind.md`), which `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` § Response formatting names as the owner of those rules.

## Proposed change

1. **Night guard.** A command hook on `UserPromptSubmit` and `SessionStart`: when local hour is 01:00–05:59, emit `additionalContext`: "Local time is HH:MM, past 1 AM. Do not propose or start new work longer than 30 minutes. Suggest a handoff and wrap-up." Outside that window, emit nothing. Ship it in `plugins/samuel/hooks/hooks.json` + a script (same pattern as `plugins/shunt/hooks/hooks.json`), with an env switch to disable (`SAMUEL_NIGHT_GUARD=0`) and a test override for the clock (`SAMUEL_NOW_HOUR`). Headless runs (`claude -p`) must not be affected: skip when the hook input shows a non-interactive session, or document why it is harmless. Optional, only if cheap: a mod band above the prompt with the same message.
2. **Context-high nudge.** A mod that reads `$.session.usage` on `turn.complete`; above a threshold (default 70%, configurable) it injects once per threshold crossing, through `prompt.context`: "Context is at N%. At the next phase boundary run /samuel:session-handoff create." State in `$.state` so it does not repeat every turn. Layout as in `/Users/sosuna/.claude/mods-spikes/pipeline-pulse/`.
3. **Dead file.** Confirm `style-contract.sh` is unregistered (`grep -c style-contract ~/.claude/settings.json` = 0) and that the output style covers its rules, then `mv ~/.claude/hooks/style-contract.sh ~/.claude/hooks/style-contract.sh.bak` (backup, then delete the backup after the owner confirms).
4. **CLAUDE.md.** After (1) is observed firing, `cp ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md.bak-$(date +%Y%m%d)` and replace line 52 with one first-person line ("I rely on the night-guard hook for the 1 AM rule; if it does not fire, I want that reported"). Under `autonomous` autonomy, steps 3 and 4 go in the PR body as pending owner steps.

## Out of scope

- Blocking prompts after 1 AM (the hook informs, it does not deny).
- A status line clock.
- Changing the output style or `sam-precision.md`.
- The PreCompact hook and the secrets mod (separate issues); share `plugins/samuel/hooks/hooks.json` if it already exists.

## Acceptance

- AC1: `echo '{}' | SAMUEL_NOW_HOUR=2 bash <night-guard script> | jq -r .hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` contains "past 1 AM"; with `SAMUEL_NOW_HOUR=14` the script prints nothing (or `{}`) and exits 0.
- AC2: The hook is registered for `UserPromptSubmit` and `SessionStart` in the plugin's `hooks/hooks.json`; `claude plugin validate plugins/samuel` reports both.
- AC3: With the clock override at 02, `claude -p "Propose a 3-hour refactor of this repo and start it." --model haiku` answers with a wrap-up/handoff suggestion (interactive check by the owner if the hook is skipped for headless runs).
- AC4: The mod passes `claude plugin validate` and `tsc --noEmit`; a unit test proves one injection per threshold crossing and none below the threshold.
- AC5: `ls ~/.claude/hooks/style-contract.sh` fails; a `.bak` copy exists until the owner confirms.
- AC6: `grep -c '1:00 AM' ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` = 0 and a dated backup exists (or the PR body lists the pending step).
- AC7: `bun run check:plugins`, `check:portability`, `check:context` pass.

## Verify it yourself

1. `echo '{}' | SAMUEL_NOW_HOUR=2 bash plugins/samuel/scripts/night-guard.sh` — expect JSON with the wrap-up text (adjust the path to where the PR put it).
2. `echo '{}' | SAMUEL_NOW_HOUR=14 bash plugins/samuel/scripts/night-guard.sh; echo $?` — expect no context and `0`.
3. After 01:00 on a real night, open a session and ask for a large new task — expect a handoff suggestion.
4. In a long session past the threshold, expect one "Context is at N%" nudge, not one per turn.
5. `ls ~/.claude/hooks/` — expect no `style-contract.sh`.
6. `grep -n '1 AM\|1:00 AM' ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` — expect only the new first-person line.

## Not verified

- `$.session.usage` is declared in this build's engine types (`'session.usage': SessionUsage`, Claude Code 2.1.287, checked 2026-10-02); confirm the field names and unit (`context.tokens`, `window`, `percent` per the blog post) against the generated `.claude-plugin/types/claude-code/index.d.ts` before building (2).
- Whether mods load on this machine in every session type (rollout switch; #63 probe d).
- That the Attention-kind output style covers every rule in `style-contract.sh` — compare the two texts before deleting.
- Whether `SessionStart` `additionalContext` is honoured the same way as `UserPromptSubmit` in 2.1.287.
- Behavioural effect: the mechanism can be proven, the change in bedtime cannot.

**Depends on:** none. Shares `plugins/samuel/hooks/hooks.json` with #64 if that lands first.

<!-- samuel:plan -->
## Executor Plan
_Not planned yet._
title: feat(samuel): the 1 AM rule and the context-high handoff become hooks; dead style hook removed
